name: estimator_comparison
scope: Controlled architecture adaptations on one frozen research robot; not upstream hardware reproduction.
questions: Does explicit state estimation improve direct history control?
Does replacing an MLP estimator with a Transformer improve control under matched supervision?
Does an HIM-style predictive context provide value beyond explicit velocity estimation?

common.estimator_frame_features: scaled_frame30 + elapsed_age_over_0.1s + valid_flag; same 32 features for both estimator backbones

model_capacity.count_scope: All deterministic deployment estimator and action-network parameters; excludes Gaussian exploration, critic, auxiliary target networks and prototypes; graph constants and buffers reported separately.

compact_ablation.enabled_by: Select one family with task-valid standard MLP and Transformer results; compress both backbones before independent confirmation. If target-device latency disqualifies standard capacity before training, revise and freeze the paired study rather than silently substituting a compact model.
compact_ablation.selection: Same validation gates and score as standard; prefer compact when tracking score is within 5 percent and no material failure, drift or jitter regression. Report differences rather than claiming statistical equivalence.

accept_compact_if.comparison_scope: each paired training seed, scenario and evaluation seed; standing drift applies only to standing scenarios

deployment_timing.backend_baseline: FP32 ONNX Runtime CPU, batch1, full estimator plus controller
measurement_conditions: record CPU model and power mode
record affinity and governor without silent system changes
paced calls at candidate control rate
measure input assembly and command submission separately from forward
deployment_timing.history_at_200hz: 16 frames spans 75ms; 31/32 frames spans 150/155ms and requires a separately counted and benchmarked configuration

estimator_training.state_target_time: same endpoint t as policy input history; never post-reset t+1
estimator_training.context_target: next same-episode proprio16 only, separately projected; exclude commands, issued actions and clock fields
estimator_training.context_pair_valid: not terminated and not truncated and next observation actually captured; no cross-reset pairs
update_order: complete all PPO epochs with estimator frozen
update estimator using owned rollout targets
validate policy change induced by estimator before next rollout
estimator_training.auxiliary_policy_kl_reference: post-PPO/pre-estimator policy on all saved rollout endpoints, fixed controller and Gaussian std
estimator_training.auxiliary_rejection: restore entire estimator-side model, optimizer, prototype/target state and random state before retry; after all attempts fail keep pre-estimator state

feasibility.actor: single-frame history MLP: frame34 includes true body_com_velocity3 and base_height1; age/valid and separate current command retained; hidden 128,64,32
feasibility.rule: Evaluate fixed 16M checkpoint; failed task gate stops for review before optional extension or full matrix; failure does not prove task impossible

screening.execution: one continuous training segment to target; evaluate immutable saved checkpoints separately

confirmation.variants: one eligible MLP-family winner and one eligible Transformer-family winner
confirmation.enabled_by: both families have task-valid candidates and uncertainty justifies confirmation

selection.primary_comparison: MLP versus Transformer within each family; cross-family comparisons are complete recipe comparisons
selection.ranking: task eligibility first; then training-seed median of worst-scenario normalized steady tracking MAE
selection.normalization: each height/vx/wz steady MAE divided by its stand-or-motion acceptance threshold; maximum over dimensions, scenarios and validation seeds per training seed
always_report: actual samples and accepted/attempted optimizer steps
selection.statistical_unit: independent training run; environments and episodes are nested observations
selection.no_eligible_candidate: report no task-valid winner; diagnose shared setup before expanding architecture search

execution.interruption: new output root with lineage, restored optimizer(s), discarded partial samples counted; environment reset disclosed
execution.global_guard: bounded queue timeout derived from job count and limits; stop only owned workers

implementation_requirements: detached estimator actor plus separate optimizer checkpoint/restore/export
version-stable PPO rollout and estimator-induced policy KL audit with transactional retries
owned same-time state targets and next-observation context targets with reset masks
paired-family configuration validation and estimator metadata
saved-checkpoint evaluation orchestration without silently using only final checkpoint
per-episode physical failure, steady MAE, world displacement and estimate-error reporting
per-step evaluation traces and source/config/checkpoint lineage
CPU contracts then bounded real simulator wiring audit before full matrix
optional_followups: matched five-frame versus sixteen-frame estimator pairs
matched joint-gradient versus detached estimator pairs
DreamWaQ-style variational context only with explicit latent replay likelihood contract
equal-budget architecture-specific hyperparameter tuning, reported separately from common-recipe comparison
